newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P says lowers Australis to CCC-plus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says lowers Australis to CCC-plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it lowered pay television operator Australis Media Ltd's corporate credit rating to CCC-plus from B-minus and removed the rating from creditwatch with negative implications where it was placed on March 20.
At the same time, S&P said the rating assigned to Australis' US$175 million subordinated notes is lowered to CCC-minus from CCC and also removed from Creditwatch with negative implications.
S&P also assigned its CCC-plus rating to Australis' proposed USS$150 million senior secured discount notes due 2002. It said the rating outlook is stable.

"The ratings reflect Australis' vulnerability of operating cash flow to several issues, mainly involving the rate of subscriber television take-up in Australia, and potential predatory pricing by competitors," it said.
